standard_prerequisites.name: The universal property of n-truncation
standard_prerequisites.statement: Precomposition with |.|_n : A -> trunc n A is an equivalence from trunc n A -> B to A -> B whenever B is an n-type.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is invoked at source line 582 to conclude that the equality of the composites comes from an equality of the functors themselves.

standard_prerequisites.name: Functoriality of truncation and its naturality homotopy
standard_prerequisites.statement: The recursion principle turns f : A -> B into trunc n f, and nat^f_n : prd a:A trunc n f(|a|_n) = |f(a)|_n.
standard_prerequisites.use: The statement is phrased with nat^f_n and nat^g_n, and the proof composes with the paths they provide.

standard_prerequisites.name: Function extensionality
standard_prerequisites.statement: A homotopy between two functions gives an equality of the functions.
standard_prerequisites.use: It converts the homotopy obtained at source line 581 into an equality before the universal property is applied.

core_obligations: Start from a homotopy with components ap(|.|_n)(h(a)) : |f(a)|_n = |g(a)|_n (source line 580).
Compose with the paths |f(a)|_n = trunc n f(|a|_n) and |g(a)|_n = trunc n g(|a|_n) arising from nat^f_n and nat^g_n to obtain a homotopy (trunc n f o |.|_n) ~ (trunc n g o |.|_n) (source line 581).
Apply function extensionality to get an equality of the two composites of functors (source line 581).

Use that precomposition with |.|_n is an equivalence to obtain a path trunc n f = trunc n g inducing it, and invoke the coherence laws for function extensionality to conclude the displayed square (source line 582).

proof_roadmap.step: Build the candidate homotopy from ap(|.|_n)(h(a)) and the naturality paths, and turn it into an equality by function extensionality.
Transport that equality across the universal property of truncation and use the coherence laws to get the specified square.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 7.3.5 at source lines 569-578: a homotopy h : f ~ g induces a homotopy trunc n h : trunc n f ~ trunc n g whose composite with the naturality paths is required to equal ap(|.|_n)(h(a)) up to a specified square. The statement is a coherence requirement, and the proof (source lines 579-583) has to manufacture it: the naive candidate is only a homotopy between the two composites after composing with the naturality paths (source line 581), so one must first turn it into an equality by function extensionality, then use that precomposition with |.|_n is an equivalence (source line 582) to lift that equality to a path between the functors, and finally appeal to the coherence laws for function extensionality to obtain a homotopy with exactly the required composite. Nothing of this is visible from the statement, whose content is only the square.
